How OpenAI Evolved, 2021–2026

From a GPT-3 API with a waitlist to ChatGPT, a developer platform, reasoning models, coding and computer-use agents, a browser and a wallet. Every OpenAI announcement this site tracks, laid out in seven lanes. Press play to watch it grow, hide lanes, or tap any dot.

Tap a dot

Each dot is one announcement. Big dots are flagship releases. The coloured bands behind are the four phases.

Dates, titles and summaries come from this site’s Frontier Lab Updates data, each with a link to its source. The lanes and the four phases are our grouping. Disclosure: Claude, made by Anthropic (an OpenAI competitor), helps write this site.
